updates.title_zh: 洲际交易所（ICE）与 trade[XYZ] 宣布计划使用 Hyperliquid 作为美国永续合约市场的基础设施层
updates.title_en: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) and trade[XYZ] have announced their plan to use
updates.what_changed_zh:
纽约证券交易所运营方洲际交易所（ICE）与 trade[XYZ] 于周四宣布，计划使用 Hyperliquid 作为基础设施层，为美国交易者提供覆盖加密资产、股票、大宗商品、外汇及其他现实世界资产的永续合约市场，但仍有待监管批准。在这一结构中，Hyperliquid 通过 HIP-3 提供底层技术，trade[XYZ] 负责设计与落地市场，ICE 负责运营受监管的市场与清算架构。

这一安排将为美国零售交易者提供一条受监管的、基于 Hyperliquid 的永续合约通道，同时为 ICE 打开进入零售交易的新入口；ICE 表示该业务将与其机构期货业务分开运行。OKX 创始人兼 CEO Star 表示，该项目由 ICE、trade[XYZ] 与 OKX 共同推进，面向零售用户的分发将通过 ICE 与 OKX 的合资公司进行。

ICE 表示已与 Trade.xyz 签署最终协议，并将担任该美国市场的独家运营方，同时设立专门的清算架构，以隔离其现有客户（其市场参与者中逾 99% 为机构）所面临的零售交易对手风险。现有的 trade[XYZ] HIP-3 市场将保持不变，HIP-3 部署方仍是独立运营者，对其自身部署负责。

updates.detailed_summary_zh: ICE and trade[XYZ] announced plans to use Hyperliquid as the infrastructure layer for regulated US perpetual futures markets spanning crypto, equities, commodities, FX, and real-world assets, pending regulatory approvals.
updates.detailed_summary_en: ICE and trade[XYZ] announced plans to use Hyperliquid as the infrastructure layer for regulated US perpetual futures markets spanning crypto, equities, commodities, FX, and real-world assets, pending regulatory approvals.
updates.background_zh: HIP-3（即“构建者部署永续合约”）是 Hyperliquid 的一项升级，于 2025 年 10 月 13 日在主网上线，允许独立运营者在 Hyperliquid 基础设施上无需许可地创建自己的永续合约市场。永续合约是没有到期日、跟踪标的资产价格的衍生品合约，据 DefiLlama 数据，Hyperliquid 是此类合约全球最大的去中心化交易所。据报道，美国总统特朗普曾在 8 月 19 日表示，CFTC 主席 Michael Selig 正在推动以“完全合规且合法的方式”将 Hyperliquid 引入美国。被列为 trade[XYZ] 投资人的亿万富翁投资者 Stanley Druckenmiller 表示“很高兴成为 trade(xyz) 的投资者”，ICE 也进行了战略投资。
updates.background_en: HIP-3, or "Builder-Deployed Perpetuals", is a Hyperliquid upgrade that went live on mainnet on October 13, 2025, allowing independent operators to permissionlessly launch their own perpetual futures markets on Hyperliquid's infrastructure. Perpetual futures are derivative contracts that track an asset's price without an expiration date, and Hyperliquid is the largest decentralized exchange for such instruments by DefiLlama data. According to the reporting, President Donald Trump said on Aug. 19 that CFTC Chair Michael Selig was working to bring Hyperliquid into the US in a "fully compliant and legal fashion." Billionaire investor Stanley Druckenmiller, listed as a trade[XYZ] investor, said he was "excited to be an investor in trade(xyz)", and ICE has made a strategic investment.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该消息直接影响了 Hyperliquid 原生代币 HYPE，其 24 小时内上涨约 20%，价格突破 96 美元，逼近 9 月创下的 97.96 美元历史高点，显示 HYPE 代币与 Hyperliquid 链上永续合约场所是市场对该消息最直接的敞口。由于该计划仍需监管批准且尚未上线，任何向美国受监管场所的推进都将通过监管与清算渠道传导，而非立竿见影的流动性变化。
updates.market_impact_en: The announcement moved Hyperliquid's native token HYPE, which rose about 20% over 24 hours to trade above $96, approaching September's all-time high of $97.96, reflecting how the HYPE token and Hyperliquid's onchain perps venue are the most direct market exposure to the news. Any shift toward a regulated US venue would transmit through the regulatory and clearing channel rather than through immediate liquidity changes, since the plan remains subject to approvals and no market is live.
